sloka: कस्यासि किमिदं भद्रे कश्च भर्ता वरानने ।येन सम्भुज्यसे भीरु स नरः पुण्यभाग्भुवि ।। ७.१७.६ ॥
transliteration: kasyāsi kimidaṁ bhadre kaśca bhartā varānane ।yena sambhujyase bhīru sa naraḥ puṇyabhāgbhuvi ।। 7.17.6 ॥

translations.english: O timid one, your incomparable beauty, which incites desire and madness in men, is not suitable for ascetic practices, for this is indeed a well-established conclusion.
